subject: Sable Tech pilot path & owners — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Carter <evelyn.carter@sabletech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-21T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed pilot path and owners (Sable Tech)

Evelyn — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed mutual action plan so we can align on owners and dates. Please flag anything we missed.

High-level pain + goals you shared
- Latency and 95th percentile spikes under ensemble routing — affects customer-facing search autosuggest and increases cost.
- Need predictable per-request latency under 150ms for critical flows and 95% cost reduction vs current self-hosted setup for non-critical batches.
- Compliance: data residency and audit logs for PII-sensitive queries.

Primary objectives for pilot
1) Validate that Redwood Dedicated can meet 95th pctl latency SLO for autosuggest within target cost band.
2) Demonstrate prefix/KV caching for your query patterns to reduce token spend.
3) Confirm integration path for audit logs and KMS-backed keys for production.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft)
- Milestone A — Pilot scope & success metrics (deliverable: pilot plan doc) — Owner: Evelyn (Sable Tech) / Jordan (Redwood) — Target: 2026-04-28
- Milestone B — Security & compliance checklist review (deliverable: checklist + gaps) — Owner: Vivek (Redwood Security) / Diego (Sable Tech) — Target: 2026-05-07
- Milestone C — Provision Dedicated capacity & sandbox access (deliverable: sandbox endpoint + creds) — Owner: Monica (Redwood CS) / Evelyn (Sable Tech) — Target: 2026-05-14
- Milestone D — Pilot run & evaluation (deliverable: perf report + cost analysis) — Owner: Monica (Redwood CS) / Evelyn (Sable Tech) — Target: 2026-05-28 (decision point)

Immediate asks from us
- Please confirm the internal stakeholders who need to be in the loop for security and procurement.
- If the dates above look off, suggest new targets and we’ll update the MAP spreadsheet.

Attachments: [sable_map_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)] — live draft with the milestones above and a simple RACI.

Next suggested steps
- I’ll update the MAP with any changes you call out and share a Drive link.
- Can we schedule a 30-minute security touchpoint the week of 5/4 to run through your checklist?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

--

Jordan — thanks for the tidy recap. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: we agree with the objectives; a few updates below.

Confirmed pain/goals
- Latency target confirmed: 95th percentile <= 150ms for autosuggest.
- Cost target: reduce token-related infra spend on non-critical batches by at least 50% for pilot (we may narrow to 30% depending on model choices).

Changes to MAP
- Add Legal review before procurement — Legal needs 1 week for contract redlines once we have proposed terms.
- Procurement: Diego (cc’d) will own vendor onboarding and budget sign-off — target procurement completion 2026-05-21.
- Decision date: we’re targeting a final decision on production rollout by 2026-05-28 but Legal could shift that out depending on redlines.

Stakeholders to include
- Diego Marquez, Procurement (diego.marquez@sabletech.com) — will lead procurement/onboarding
- Priya Singh, Head of Search (priya.singh@sabletech.com) — she’ll validate metric thresholds during pilot
- Security will send the standard requirements doc; I’m attaching our current internal requirements for reference.

Attachment: [sable_requirements_v2.pdf] — this contains a short security/controls checklist and a draft outline of required logs and retention.

Next steps
- Please incorporate Legal and Procurement milestones into your MAP.
- Confirm a security touchpoint — Diego, can you propose 2 slots next week?

Evelyn
